Hi Emily— following up from Marissa's note. High-level answers to the questions we expect on your security questionnaire: 

- Data residency: For hosted API customers, data is processed in our US regions by default; we offer EU-only processing for customers who require it (private/dedicated options available).
- Data retention: By default, request/response logs are retained for 30 days for observability; we offer retention configuration and stricter retention for Private deployments.
- Encryption: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed keys via KMS supported for Private deployments.
- Access controls: Role-based access with audit logging; SSO + SCIM provisioning supported.

I've attached a short SOC2 summary that covers scope and last audit date. Full SOC2 report can be shared under NDA — let me know if you need the full pack and I'll route it via our security team.

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
